lines: Most people never get what they want. Here is the five step system.
One. Name it. Specific, hard goals beat vague ones. Add a deadline.
Two. Plan it. If this happens, then I do that. Triggers beat willpower.
Three. Ask. People underestimate how often others say yes, by about half.
Four. Reach moderately weak ties. Not strangers. Not best friends.
Five. Adjust. Keep the goal fixed. Change the method.
Write your goal, with a deadline, in the comments. The full film is on the channel.
